work_packages.title: Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state
objectives: Acquire and harmonise Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, soil-sensor and weather data into a unified EO-ground fusion pipeline.
Implement and calibrate a probabilistic field-state estimator producing a posterior for root-zone soil moisture and crop water stress.

tasks.title: Acquire and harmonise EO and ground sensor data
Calibrate and evaluate diagnostic branch output

work_packages.title: Uncertainty-aware decision engine and demonstrator integration
objectives: Build an uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration module retaining a parameter posterior for counterfactual irrigation simulation.
Integrate diagnostic and decision branches into a standalone research demonstrator web MVP.

tasks.title: Build counterfactual irrigation simulation and decision engine
Integrate diagnosis and decision into research demonstrator

work_packages.title: Field validation, ground truth and uncertainty calibration
objectives: Collect ground truth data and run the validation protocol against diagnostic branch outputs.
Assess uncertainty calibration quality and test Route B patch-covariation assumptions.

tasks.title: Design validation protocol and ground truth collection
Assess uncertainty calibration against field data

work_packages.title: Training, supervision and two-way transfer of knowledge
objectives: Prepare and maintain a Career Development Plan and deliver ≥120 hours of transferable-skills training across MSCA-PF mandatory dimensions.
Facilitate two-way transfer of knowledge between fellow and host through methods seminars and co-supervision of ≥1 MSc thesis.

tasks.title: Prepare and maintain Career Development Plan

work_packages.title: Dissemination, exploitation, communication and management
objectives: Deliver open-science outputs including a FAIR data management plan by month 6 and open-access publications.
Execute project communication, exploitation logic and lightweight management and ethics oversight.

tasks.title: Develop and maintain data management plan

edges.derivation: WP2 objective explicitly states integration of WP1 diagnostic branch outputs into the decision engine and demonstrator.
WP3 objective explicitly states the validation protocol is run against WP1 diagnostic branch outputs.

T2-01 implements uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration; AquaCrop calibration requires the root-zone soil moisture and crop water stress posterior produced by T1-03 (calibrate and evaluate diagnostic branch output).
T2-03 title explicitly states 'Integrate diagnosis and decision into research demonstrator'; the diagnosis branch output (calibrated in T1-03) is a mandatory data input to the integration task.

WP3 objective states the validation protocol targets diagnostic branch outputs; T3-01 designs that protocol and therefore requires the diagnostic branch output specification from T1-03 to define validation criteria.
T3-02 assesses uncertainty calibration quality of the WP1 probabilistic field-state estimator; this directly requires the calibrated model output from T1-03.
T5-02 publishes open-access research outputs; WP1 diagnostic branch findings (T1-03) constitute primary research results requiring publication.
T5-02 publishes open-access research outputs; the integrated research demonstrator produced by T2-03 and associated WP2 findings are primary research outputs requiring publication.

T5-02 publishes open-access research outputs; WP3 validation and uncertainty calibration results (T3-02, D3-01 due month 24) are the final empirical research findings and must be available before definitive open-access publication.
